text: roblox-devforum-mcp 是面向 AI 编程助手的 DSH 插件，可在 Web 或其他支持 MCP 的客户端中查询 Roblox 开发者论坛和官方 Creator Docs。它通过 stdio 启动 MCP 服务，提供论坛搜索、Bug 主题筛选、主题与回复阅读、文档搜索、引擎 API 检查和近期更新摘要。助手可用它查找相似错误、核对 API 状态与弃用信息，并查看 Roblox 发布动态，适合 Luau 与 Roblox Studio 开发排障。无需 API Key 或登录；运行需要 Node.js 20 以上，并会访问公开论坛和官方文档服务。

roblox-devforum-mcp lets AI agents search the Roblox Developer Forum and official Creator Docs. Its stdio MCP tools find forum topics, read threads, check engine APIs, and summarize updates for Luau debugging. No API key or login is required; Node.js 20 or later is needed.
我想让编程助手搜索 Roblox 开发者论坛里的相似报错。
怎么查一个 Roblox API 有没有弃用或者拼写错？
希望 AI 能直接查 Roblox Creator Docs 并读完整页面。
遇到 Roblox Studio 的 Bug，想找论坛里已经讨论过的解决办法。
能不能让助手查看一个 DevForum 主题和它的回复？
我想确认 Luau 代码里用到的类和方法是否仍然可用。
想知道最近 Roblox 平台更新了什么，判断问题是不是版本变化导致的。
Find similar Roblox error reports on the developer forum for my coding assistant.
roblox-devforum-mcp 的功能「论坛与 Bug 搜索」：助手可按关键词查询 DevForum，并用分类、标签、解决状态、点赞数和日期筛选；search_bugs 聚焦 Bug 报告，返回主题供后续阅读。
roblox-devforum-mcp 的功能「主题阅读」：助手传入主题 ID 或链接即可读取帖子，并可分页获取长主题回复；结果整理为 Markdown，便于查看答案和代码片段。
roblox-devforum-mcp 的功能「官方文档与 API 查询」：可搜索并读取 Creator Docs，也能批量检查类、成员和 Luau API 的存在、大小写、弃用及安全级别。
roblox-devforum-mcp 的功能「平台更新摘要」：助手可读取 Weekly Recap 档案，或汇总指定时间范围内的近期更新，帮助追查近期行为变化。
roblox-devforum-mcp 使用前须知：搜索词会发送到 DevForum 查询公开主题；文档和 API 查询会访问 Roblox Creator Docs 及 GitHub 托管的公开资料。

roblox-devforum-mcp README · Introduction：

roblox-devforum-mcp README · roblox-devforum-mcp：An [MCP](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) server that gives an AI coding agent the **Roblox
Developer Forum** and the **official creator docs**.

When your agent hits a Roblox bug, it can check whether Roblox already has it triaged, read the
accepted answer, and confirm the API before writing Luau.

No API key, no login, no setup.

roblox-devforum-mcp README · Install：```bash
claude mcp add roblox-devforum -- npx -y roblox-devforum-mcp
```

[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add roblox-devforum-mcp
```

roblox-devforum-mcp README · Tools：| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `search_devforum` | Search the forum. Filters for category, tag, solved-only, likes and date. Pass several phrasings to run them at once. |
| `search_bugs` | Search only the bug-report categories, so a hit means somebody reported the same symptom. |
| `get_thread` | Read a topic as Markdown, accepted answer first, code blocks intact. |
| `get_replies` | Page through a long thread. |
| `list_recent` | Latest or top topics in a category or tag. |
| `list_categories` | Every category and tag slug the filters accept. |
| `search_creator_docs` | Search the docs by page content; pass `path` (or a docs URL) to read a page in full. |
| `get_engine_api` | Signatures, security levels and deprecations for classes, enums, datatypes and Luau libraries. |
| `check_api_health` | Check APIs before you ship: removed, deprecated, wrong case, security-gated, yielding. |
| `get_whats_new` | Recent platform changes — for "this worked last week". |
| `get_weekly_recap` | Any Roblox Weekly Recap, current or historical. |

roblox-devforum-mcp README · Tools：Every tool is read-only, returns Markdown with source URLs, and stays inside a token budget.

`[answered]` beside a result means a reply was marked as the solution — by whoever opened the
thread, not by Roblox. Roblox does not publish a triage state, so read the thread to see
whether staff replied.

roblox-devforum-mcp README · Example：> *"My DataStore:SetAsync keeps failing with `502: API Services rejected request`. Is this on
> Roblox's end?"*

The agent runs `search_bugs` on the error text, `get_thread` on the best hit, then
`check_api_health` before touching your code.

roblox-devforum-mcp README · Configuration：| Variable | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DEVFORUM_CACHE_TTL` | `300` | Search cache lifetime, in seconds. |
| `DEVFORUM_TIMEOUT_MS` | `12000` | Per-request timeout. |
| `DEVFORUM_DEADLINE_MS` | `24000` | Total time one request may spend, retries included. |
| `DEVFORUM_MAX_RETRIES` | `3` | Retries on 429 and 5xx. |
| `DEVFORUM_CONCURRENCY` | `4` | Simultaneous requests to the DevForum. |
| `DEVFORUM_CDN_CONCURRENCY` | `8` | Simultaneous requests to GitHub-hosted docs. |
| `DEVFORUM_DOCS_SCAN` | `14` | Doc pages scored per search. |
| `DEVFORUM_CACHE_DIR` | OS temp dir | Where the API dump and docs index are cached. |
| `DEVFORUM_BASE_URL` | `https://devforum.roblox.com` | Point at another Discourse instance. |
roblox-devforum-mcp README · Configuration：A bad value is ignored, with a note on stderr, and the default is used.

roblox-devforum-mcp README · Data sources：[devforum.roblox.com](https://devforum.roblox.com) (public Discourse API),
[Roblox/creator-docs](https://github.com/Roblox/creator-docs), and the
[Roblox-Client-Tracker](https://github.com/MaximumADHD/Roblox-Client-Tracker) API dump.
